artistic_impressions.justification: Artist concept of Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter at Mars. No photograph of the flown spacecraft in orbit exists; the gallery's photographs show the launch, the assembly and what the orbiter's camera saw. The operator approved this hero on 2026-11-15.

Artist concept of Mariner 2 in space. No photograph of the flown spacecraft in flight exists; the gallery's photographs show a ground engineering model and the people and data of the mission. The operator approved the staged hero candidates on 2026-11-15.
